definitions.explanation: A system of supervised release in which offenders live in the community under the guidance of a probation officer rather than serving time in prison. Applies to both those given suspended sentences and those released on parole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被告人|ひこくにん}→被告人：20130_hikokunin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{保護観察|ほごかんさつ}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{執行猶予|しっこうゆうよ}→執行猶予：18434_shikkouyuuyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The defendant received a suspended sentence with probation.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧ (protection, supervision) and ⟦{観察|かんさつ}→観察：02558_kansatsu⟧ (observation, monitoring). In Japan's criminal justice system, probation is carried out largely by volunteer {保護司|ほごし} (probation officers) — community members who assist in the rehabilitation of offenders.

USAGE:
Commonly encountered in news about criminal cases, especially sentencing. The phrase {保護観察付き執行猶予|ほごかんさつつきしっこうゆうよ} (suspended sentence with probation) is a standard legal outcome. Also applies to juvenile offenders released from reformatories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保護観察|ほごかんさつ}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with probation attached
- {保護観察|ほごかんさつ}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: during probation
- {保護観察|ほごかんさつ}⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧: probation disposition
- {保護観察|ほごかんさつ}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: probation period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{執行猶予|しっこうゆうよ}→執行猶予：18434_shikkouyuuyo⟧: suspended sentence — the sentence itself may or may not include probation
- ⟦{仮釈放|かりしゃくほう}→仮釈放：22608_karishakuhou⟧: parole — early release from prison, which is typically accompanied by probation
- {保護司|ほごし}: probation officer — the volunteer who supervises offenders in the community
- ⟦{更生|こうせい}→更生：18057_kousei⟧: rehabilitation, reform — the broader concept of an offender returning to a law-abiding life
